codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the feature intent: edge-case fixture preflight now checks per-category marker completeness, auto-rebuilds incomplete categories, and fails fast if incompleteness persists. This removes the previous single-directory readiness heuristic and is compatible with baseline-and-fixtures verification expectations.

issues.description: The test module docstring claims coverage for `_preflight_edge_fixtures()` auto-setup behavior, but the suite does not directly exercise that function; the closest test only asserts `setup_categories` is callable. This leaves the run_matrix preflight integration path under-unit-tested and more regression-prone.

`_resolve_needed_edge_categories()` hardcodes edge scenario-to-category mapping separately from `manifests/scenarios.json` and `REQUIRED_MARKERS`; if edge scenarios/groups evolve without updating this map, preflight can silently skip required categories.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared guidance does not document a single-source-of-truth convention for edge scenario/category mapping used by preflight logic, increasing drift risk between manifests and run_matrix helpers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `scripts/parity/run_matrix.py:362` defines a hardcoded `_SCENARIO_TO_CATEGORY` map while edge scenarios are declared in `manifests/scenarios.json`; mission guidance files (`/Users/ragas/.factory/missions/d1c51473-4105-4ffd-8739-51d144ec03b4/AGENTS.md`, `.factory/library/*.md`) do not define synchronization expectations for this mapping.
